items.title: Jonathan Ross 'horrified' by Walliams allegations and Brand conviction
items.summary: The TV presenter says he was once "friendly" with David Walliams and Russell Brand, but was "genuinely unaware" of their conduct.

items.title: Police address 'violent incident' claim against Russell Brand made by Jemima Goldsmith
items.summary: Police have addressed an alleged "violent incident" involving Russell Brand after claims made his then-girlfriend Jemima Goldsmith.

items.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
items.summary: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

items.title: Threatening emails sent to hundreds of schools in Northern Ireland, Scotland and Italy treated as 'hoaxes'
items.summary: Threatening emails sent to hundreds of schools across Northern Ireland, Scotland and Italy are being treated as hoaxes, authorities have said.

items.title: Police told Russell Brand to leave Jemima Goldsmith's house in 2014
items.summary: Police confirm they asked Brand to leave his ex-girlfriend's house after she reported an alleged assault.

items.title: Strike by consultant doctors in England paused
items.summary: A strike by consultant doctors in England has been paused following meetings with the government, the British Medical Association (BMA) announced.
